question: What spiritual accomplishment follows from the observance of proper conduct?
premises: Observance of conduct has a result.
That result is the accomplishment of the command.
inference: Observing proper conduct truly brings about the accomplishment of the command.
uncertainties: The exact scope of ājñāsiddhi is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Truly, from the observance of proper conduct, the accomplishment of the command will come to be.
